business_problem: Hong Leong Bank needed to replace slow manual banking operations and limited chatbot performance with a secure AI ecosystem that could support dynamic customer support, document-heavy trade operations, sanction screening, and faster software delivery.
solution_summary: Hong Leong Bank built its AI ecosystem on Google Cloud with Gemini platform as the secure environment for internal and customer-facing agents. The bank runs Gemini as a private instance to minimize data exposure. For customer service, it replaced a static open-source chatbot with Gemini 2.5 Flash in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation architecture, then used the Agent Development Kit to coordinate specialized agents that call backend APIs and retrieve real-time core-banking data for personalized responses and promotions. Document AI handles trade-finance OCR across invoices and shipping forms and supports sanction screening for credit-underwriting teams. Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, and Google Cloud Search support the wider application environment, while Gemini Code Assist improves developer productivity. This gives HLB one platform for conversational banking, document automation, risk controls, and faster software delivery.

solution_components.name: Document AI

solution_components.role: Supplies enterprise search capabilities inside the wider banking solution landscape.

solution_components.role: Improves developer productivity and reduces development time for DevOps workflows.

data_flow: Customer or employee requests are interpreted by Gemini 2.5 Flash in Gemini platform, which uses ADK-driven agents to call secure backend banking APIs and return real-time answers. Trade-finance and underwriting documents are processed through Document AI, while the wider application environment relies on Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, and search services.
business_outcome: Hong Leong Bank increased chatbot accuracy and engagement, sped up document-heavy operations, reduced development time, and created a secure platform for expanding agentic banking services.
